article.summary_es: La Iglesia Bautista St. Albans aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos en Saint Albans, Queens. Abre los sábados de 10am a 12pm, pero la despensa funciona solo el primer y tercer sábado del mes.
article.summary_en: St. Albans Baptist Church appears on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry in Saint Albans, Queens. It is open Saturdays 10am-12pm, but the pantry runs on the 1st and 3rd Saturday only.
